name: io.github.kurcontko/mnemotree
title: Mnemotree
description: Local long-term memory. Keeps messages verbatim in SQLite and recalls them by hybrid search.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOTREE_DB
environmentVariables.description: SQLite file that holds the memories. Defaults to ~/.mnemotree/memory.sqlite.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOTREE_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: Namespace this server reads and writes. Defaults to "default".

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOTREE_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for one namespace per project: the Git repository around the client's project directory.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOTREE_LEXICAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for keyword-only search, which skips the 200 MB embedding model download.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOTREE_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: JSON config file that replaces the local embedding model, for example with an HTTP embedder.
